build.environment: Ubuntu Linux 64-bit · Node/Vite Production Bundle (/abrn/) · Live HTTPS https://abrndrive.filemonprime.net/abrn/files · Real Chromium via bsk (1632x940@2x) + Physical Android 13 (waydroid-android-13, 427x721) via filemon_mobile_client.py

requirements.description: Preserve Subir y Ordenar (Auto) and Cuadre BBVA; remove RAM/0ms implementation pills; humanize topbar search, mobile Dynamic Island (Privado), viewport bar (PC | PC + Celular | Vista Celular), 3-skin selector (Claro | Gris | Negro), FileSearch (Buscar dentro · Cerebro Ciego), and Spanish CommandPalette (Bóveda + Acciones Rápidas).

Replace leaked NOT_EVALUABLE · BÓVEDA EN REPOSO / SIN_CFDI_EN_CARPETA enums with plain Spanish while keeping No-False-Zeros (—), Papel Trabajo .CSV, and 100% amarrado, and pair primary real upload CTA with honestly labeled Probar con ejemplo (3 CFDI + BBVA).

Humanize SmartUploadOrderModal, WhatsAppDropRequestModal, VaultAccessCenterInline (aligned with docs/trust-copy-contract.md), and Spanish StagingDock (Seleccionados, Enviar por WhatsApp, Quitar acceso, Deseleccionar).

Humanize Inspector, FilePreviewModal, and FilemonOfficeStage (Imagen, Pantalla completa, ¿Quién tiene acceso a este archivo?, Resumen rápido · Privado, client-neutral SAT labels), remove fake VOZ 0:12 badges on unannotated files, and ship real localStorage-persisted editable/deletable Nota rápida notes.

Preserve warm PIN prompt, Pulso Fiscal, Expediente, Cola de Trabajo Hoy, and 5-slot dock; humanize VaultPrivacyShutter (Tus archivos están ocultos), MobileScannerSheet (Va directo a la bóveda — no se queda en tus fotos), MobileInspectorSheet, ContinuumDockPane, and public/previews/{index,mobile}.html.

Zero TypeScript errors, 19/19 focused Vitest suites passing (161/161 tests including 91/91 7-skin WCAG contrast assertions and continuum-bridge.test.ts), and clean Vite production bundle under /abrn/.

Cold live Desktop verification via bsk (live-01..05) and physical Android 13 (427x721, overflowPx: 0, live-06..08, hardware Back dismissal, autonomous_audit PASSED, lease released) with untouched abrndrive.service.

findings.reproduction: Inspect filter underline tabs and bottom keyboard hint bar on /abrn/files.
findings.expected: Filter tabs and shortcut bar use natural plain Spanish without 4K, Drop, #key, or 94vw CSS tokens.
findings.actual: files.tsx still showed '4K y Video', 'Recibidos Drop', 'Enlaces #key', and 'Enter 94vw'.
findings.cause: Secondary sub-controls in files.tsx retained implementation tokens from v22.
findings.fix: Renamed to 'Imagen y Video', 'Recibidos', 'Compartidos', and 'Enter abrir' in files.tsx.

findings.reproduction: Hover file rows or open right-click VaultContextMenu on /abrn/files.
findings.expected: Fullscreen viewer action reads 'Abrir en pantalla completa'.
findings.actual: FileGrid.tsx and VaultContextMenu.tsx showed 'Abrir en Visor 94vw'.
findings.cause: Viewport CSS width string leaked into action tooltips and context menu label.
findings.fix: Replaced 'Abrir en Visor 94vw' with 'Abrir en pantalla completa' in FileGrid.tsx and VaultContextMenu.tsx.

findings.reproduction: Open MobileInspectorSheet on a mobile file row.
findings.expected: Format tab says 'Imagen' and stage labels explain private viewing in plain Spanish.
findings.actual: MobileInspectorSheet.tsx showed '4K', 'Blob URL Efímero en RAM', and '(Descifrado Streaming)'.
findings.cause: Mobile inspector stage strings mirrored v21 technical implementation terms.
findings.fix: Updated MobileInspectorSheet.tsx to 'Imagen', 'Vista privada sin guardar copia en galería', and 'Abrir documento completo'.

findings.reproduction: Inspect collapsed sidebar tooltip / accessible label for Pedir Documentos.
findings.expected: Accessible label reads 'Pedir Documentos' without duplicate 'Drop'.
findings.actual: sidebar.tsx concatenated badge text to produce 'Buzón Drop Drop'.
findings.cause: Legacy badge label in sidebar.tsx accounting navigation array.
findings.fix: Renamed item label to 'Pedir Documentos' without redundant badge suffix in sidebar.tsx.

findings.reproduction: Open Cuadre BBVA on an empty folder at 1632px desktop width with 3 panes visible.
findings.expected: Empty-state explanation wraps comfortably across the card width with clear CTA buttons underneath.
findings.actual: lg:flex-row squeezed the left explanation column when paired with two side-by-side CTA buttons inside the center pane.
findings.cause: Horizontal flex row competed with the two-button CTA group inside the ~720px center column.
findings.fix: Changed VaultReconcileCockpit.tsx empty-state card layout to flex-col gap-4 with sm:pl-[52px] button alignment.

findings.reproduction: Open Cmd+K in Spanish locale and open PC + Celular phone mirror on /abrn/files.
findings.expected: Cmd+K displays Spanish 'Bóveda' group labels and embedded phone mirror shows an unobstructed '🔒 Privado' Dynamic Island.
findings.actual: command-palette.tsx showed English 'Vault Operations' / 'Lock Vault Privacy Shutter', and ContinuumDockPane.tsx rendered an extra outer camera dot over mobile.html's Dynamic Island.
findings.cause: Hardcoded English fallback strings in command-palette.tsx and duplicate bezel overlay in ContinuumDockPane.tsx.
findings.fix: Localized Spanish Bóveda commands in command-palette.tsx and removed the duplicate outer camera dot in ContinuumDockPane.tsx.
